name: Air Metal VA
old_description: Founded in 1970, Air Metal has been serving the Central Virginia region with high quality custom sheet metal & roofing work for over 50 years.
about:
Air Metal was founded in 1970 by Douglas and Gladys Smith in Richmond, Virginia. The family-owned business has served the Central Virginia region for over five decades, building a reputation for custom sheet metal fabrication and metal roofing. Since 2021, the company has continued the legacy established by the Smiths, operating a fabrication shop with over 60 years of combined fabrication experience.

The company operates a full-service fabrication shop producing a wide range of sheet metal products. Core offerings include standing seam roofing panels in snap lock (1" or 1.5"), mechanical lock (1", 1.5", or 2"), and nail strip (1" or 1.5") profiles, as well as 5V Crimp panels and commercial 2" mechanical lock systems. The shop also fabricates metal soffit and wall panels, fascia, valleys, coping, drip edge, and custom accessories such as chimney caps, cupolas, conductor heads, and vents. Historic duplication of metalwork is a noted specialty. In addition, Air Metal manufactures HVAC components including ducting and fittings, plenums, diffuser boxes, and register boxes.

Air Metal serves contractors, builders, and property owners across the construction, roofing, and HVAC industries in Central Virginia. Its products are used in both residential and commercial projects, from custom gutter systems to large-scale commercial standing seam roofs. The company emphasizes its ability to handle projects of any size, supported by its in-house fabrication capabilities.

The company distinguishes itself through its deep fabrication experience and focus on weather-resistant roofing systems suited to Virginia's climate. The Smiths' original commitment to quality remains a guiding principle, and the current team highlights the shop's combined six decades of hands-on expertise as a key differentiator for customers seeking custom metal solutions.
